meta.title: Session state machine
meta.subtitle: Four states; Stale is console-side only

transitions.label: HMAC challenge answered
transitions.note: The console sends AUTH_OK and only then does command traffic begin.

transitions.label: handshake failed or auth timeout
transitions.note: An unknown identity is refused before any challenge is issued.

transitions.label: peer dead, stream error, or EOF
newer session for the same identity
transitions.note: The stale session is ineligible for commands and its timers stop.

cards.title: Timers
items: auth timeout 10,000 ms: the handshake must complete in time
command timeout 30,000 ms: the command fails, the session survives
keepalive interval 10,000 ms: one PING per interval while established
keepalive window 30,000 ms: no inbound frame means the session goes down

cards.title: Invariants
items: Every valid inbound frame is a life sign, not just PONGs
A failed, timed-out, or cancelled command never poisons the session: the next command runs normally
Down is terminal: the agent redials with a fresh session

cards.title: One Live Session Per Identity
items: When an agent re-dials, the newest session wins
The superseded-but-connected session shows as stale until it disconnects
The visible registry state is derived at query time, never cached
